settings.intro_text: Hot weather changes what feels good to wear. When temperatures climb, fresh and cooling scents feel far more comfortable than rich, heavy ones that can turn overwhelming. settings.title: Cooling & Refreshing

settings.title: Find Your Hot Weather Signature

settings.question: What type of perfume is best for hot weather?
settings.answer: Hot weather perfumes usually feature fresh, cooling notes like citrus, mint, marine accords, and light florals because they stay crisp and comfortable when heavy, rich scents would feel overwhelming.

settings.question: Which perfumes feel cooling in the heat?
settings.answer: Citrus, mint, and aquatic fragrances feel most cooling in heat because their fresh, crisp character lifts you rather than sitting heavy, making them ideal for hot summer days.

settings.question: Should perfume be lighter in hot weather?
settings.answer: Yes. Heat intensifies fragrance, so lighter Eau de Toilette and cologne concentrations are more comfortable, while rich, sweet, or heavy scents can quickly become overpowering in hot conditions.

settings.question: Do perfumes fade faster in hot weather?
settings.answer: Yes. Warm temperatures speed up evaporation, so scents can fade sooner in the heat. Applying to moisturised skin and reapplying lightly helps a fresh fragrance last through a hot day.

settings.question: Can I wear sweet perfumes in hot weather?
settings.answer: You can, but lightly. Sweet, rich notes can feel heavy and cloying in the heat, so fresher citrus and aquatic scents are usually more comfortable, or apply sweeter fragrances sparingly.
